question_text: The bellow prism of refractive index $\mu$ as shown in figure, is made of a material of thick walls. A ray of monochromatic light PQ travelling in air is incident on the glass prism as shown in figure. In order to make the emergent ray travel along Y and Z directions respectively, the cavity of hollow surface should be filled with transparent fluids of refractive index $\mu_1$ and $\mu_2$ respectively.
